name: Last Day in Life
source:
Ben woke up and found his wife dead next to him.
He did not mourn or weep, but felt it was fair because of their age.
Ben decided to do his routine; make tea.
He thought long enough and finally made an important decision for his life.
translation:
本醒来后发现妻子死在了身旁。
他没有悲伤或哭泣，只是觉得以他们的年龄这是公平的。
本决定照常做他的日常——泡茶。
他思考了很久，最终为自己的人生做出了一个重要的决定。
